review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Many people believe that advertising plays a key role in economic developments, while others concern it could adversely affect the society. From my perspective, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, advertising bring various undeniable economic benefits. Initially, creative content with appealing visual effects might significantly stimulate consumer. Consequently, the spending power would be increased, leading to the encouragement of production throughout the whole country. Hence, more there would be more opportunities for people who are unemployed and greater state revenues through taxation. Moreover, more different occupations in the field of marketing, media and design are created, making it an important driver of economic activity.

On the other hand, some people argued that advertising has negative social consequences. Firstly, advertising constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. A realistic example is that young people, in particular, feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, consequently resulting in frustration when they cannot afford them. To a further extent, advertising promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, while both views are valid to some certain extent. Although advertising contribute to social dissatisfaction, it also plays a crucial role in economic development.

annotations.explanation: “Concern” có thể là danh từ, chẳng hạn “a concern”, hoặc động từ ngoại động từ theo mẫu “something concerns somebody”. Ở đây em muốn nói “những người khác lo ngại rằng…”, nên không thể viết “others concern it could…”. Dùng “others are concerned that…”: “concerned” là tính từ đứng sau “are”, còn “that” mở mệnh đề nêu điều họ lo ngại. Nếu chỉ muốn nêu một quan điểm, em có thể dùng “others believe that…”.

annotations.explanation: Lỗi nằm ở hòa hợp chủ ngữ–động từ trong cụm “advertising bring”. Advertising là số ít. Cách sửa “advertising brings” giữ nguyên ý nhưng đưa từ/cụm từ về đúng chức năng ngữ pháp trong câu.
annotations.title: Động từ số ít

annotations.explanation: Cụm “stimulate consumer” chưa diễn đạt đúng hoặc tự nhiên trong ngữ cảnh này. Cần nêu thứ được kích thích là consumer demand. Dùng “stimulate consumer demand” vì cụm này mang đúng nghĩa em cần và kết hợp từ tự nhiên hơn.

paragraphs: Many people believe that advertising plays a key role in economic development, whereas others are concerned that it could adversely affect society. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content with appealing visual effects can significantly stimulate consumer demand. Consequently, spending power increases, encouraging production throughout the country. Hence, more employment opportunities are created and state revenues increase through taxation. For example, online retailers can use advertising campaigns to reach more customers and expand the digital market. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media, and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. It constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, and luxury possessions, which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, resulting in frustration when they cannot afford them. In the long run, advertising promotes materialistic values and a money-driven culture.
In conclusion, I believe both views are valid to a certain extent. Although advertising contributes to social dissatisfaction, it also plays a crucial role in economic development.

Thay consumer bằng consumer demand, rồi sửa bring/show/promote theo chủ ngữ số ít.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
